title: Swing Arm Towel Rail 12.5-Inch Solid Brass, Double Arm | Shaded Beige | Assorted Wall Accessories | Allied Brass
short_title: Waverly Place 2 Swing Arm Towel Rail 12.5-Inch, Shaded Beige
description:
Keep towels within reach without giving up wall space—two pivoting arms swing out when you need them and fold close to the wall when you don’t in Shaded Beige, which offers sophisticated warmth in a soft, neutral tone that complements natural materials and earthy palettes. Designed for organized, flexible bathroom towel storage with a clean, finished look.

Highlights:
- Shaded Beige transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Maintain a clean, tailored look: concealed screw mounting hardware
- Built for lasting use: crafted from solid brass

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 12.5 x 7.1 x 7 inches
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 18 x 12 x 12 inches
- Shipping weight: 7 lbs
- Wall-mounted; concealed screw mounting hardware included
- Collection context: Assorted Wall Accessories collection
- Style: transitional bathroom hardware with versatile bath accessories
multiple designer finish options available
